characters.summary: Aerith fights primarily as a spellcaster, utilizing magical staves to cast white magic, elemental spells, and defensive wards. She operates mostly from a distance, supporting allies with healing and barrier magic while manipulating the battlefield with magical zones.
weaknesses: Low physical durability compared to front-line combatants
limitations: Relies on MP for advanced magical abilities

sources.supports: Abilities, magical aptitude, and combat style in Final Fantasy VII Remake

notableResults.note: Ambushed and fatally wounded at the Forgotten Capital

Casts healing spells like Cure

unknowns: Full extent of her ancient Cetra abilities outside of standard white magic remains mysterious

limitations: Requires preparation and stealth for maximum effectiveness

characters.summary: Albert Wesker utilizes superhuman speed, strength, and regenerative capabilities derived from the Progenitor virus variant. He closes distance rapidly in combat, overwhelming opponents with close-quarters martial arts and kinetic force.
weaknesses: Vulnerable to massive overdoses of PG67A/W serum which suppresses his virus stability
limitations: Arrogance often leads him to toy with opponents rather than executing them immediately

sources.supports: Albert Wesker's superhuman powers, abilities, and feats in Resident Evil 5

feats.claim: Dodged multiple point-blank gunfire rounds effortlessly

notableResults.note: Defeated inside a volcano after continuous exposure to suppressing serum and rocket fire

campaignTags.claim: Possesses accelerated healing and resistance to lethal trauma
Recovers from heavy injuries rapidly due to viral mutation

unknowns: Full limits of his physical strength before maximum Uroboros integration

characters.summary: Alduin, the World-Eater, is a divine dragon capable of devastating foes with massive physical strength, tail swipes, razor-sharp bites, and potent draconic Shouts. He controls battlefield weather and breathes destructive fire.

mechanisms: Immunity to standard mortal weapons outside of Dragonrend

weaknesses: Vulnerable to the Dragonrend Shout which forces him to land and experience mortal mortality
limitations: Bound to the will of time until his appointed cycle, susceptible to the Dragonrend Thu'um

sources.supports: Alduin's lore, shouts, abilities, and status as the World-Eater

characters.summary: As a Death Knight, Arthas abandons holy magic for dark necromancy, wielding the cursed runeblade Frostmourne. He drains life from foes, raises the dead to fight for him, and commands icy death magic.
weaknesses: Bound to the Lich King's command structure until taking the crown

characters.summary: As the Lich King, Arthas commands absolute dominion over the Scourge, wielding immense necromantic, frost, and soul-reaving power through Frostmourne and the Helm of Domination. He freezes opponents in place and can instantly terminate foes with necrotic fury.

mechanisms: Undead immunity to fatigue and pain

weaknesses: Hubris and inner conflict with the remaining humanity of Terenas/Arthas within his psyche
characters.formDifferences: Fused with Ner'zhul's spirit and the Helm of Domination, elevating him from a mortal death knight to the supreme ruler of the undead with planetary-scale necromantic influence.

sources.supports: The Lich King's god-like undead powers, Frostmourne, and campaign lore in Wrath of the Lich King

Wields overwhelming control over frost and blizzards
Wields Frostmourne to reap souls and freeze targets
